label: CVLI rate per 100k
expression: SUM(cvli_victims) * 12.0 / MAX(months_covered) * 100000 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN has_sinesp_records THEN population END), 0)
description: Annualized CVLI victims per 100,000 inhabitants of the selected municipalities with SINESP records. Victims without informed municipality are not included (see state_profile).

label: National hotspots
expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_national_hotspot THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

label: State hotspots
expression: SUM(CASE WHEN is_state_hotspot THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

label: High-High municipalities
expression: SUM(CASE WHEN lisa_cluster = 'High-High' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

label: Average IVSC
description: Simple average of the Social & Criminal Vulnerability Index (0 to 1) of the selected municipalities.

label: CVLI rate per 100k
description: Annualized CVLI victims per 100,000 inhabitants of the selected states, including victims without informed municipality.

label: CVLI rate per 100k (annualized)
description: Annualized CVLI rate of the selected states. Valid per month and over several months, because every row carries its state population.

label: CVLI rate per 100k (annualized)
description: Annualized CVLI victims per 100,000 inhabitants of the selected areas and months. Valid for any filter, because every row carries the population of its area.

label: Year-over-year change in CVLI
expression: CASE WHEN COUNT(cvli_victims_previous_year) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(cvli_victims) / NULLIF(SUM(cvli_victims_previous_year), 0) - 1 END
description: CVLI victims of the selected months against the same months of the previous year. Null when any of those previous months is missing from the data.

label: Period rate
description: Annualized CVLI rate of the whole selection, the same value on every row of the chart. Reference line of the rate trend.
